title: Koszul complex of a finite sequence of ring elements
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $r\ge0$, and $f_1,\dots,f_r\in R$. Let $E=R^{\oplus r}$ be the free $R$-module [def-weil-pbc-free-module] with standard basis $e_1,\dots,e_r$, and $\varphi:E\to R$ the $R$-linear map with $\varphi(e_i)=f_i$. Let $\wedge(E)=\bigoplus_{n\ge0}\wedge^n_R(E)$ be the exterior algebra of $E$ with its exterior powers [def-weil-pbc-exterior-algebra], and $D=D_\varphi:\wedge(E)\to\wedge(E)$ the unique $R$-linear map with $D(1)=0$ and $D(v\wedge x)=\varphi(v)x-v\wedge D(x)$ ($v\in E$, $x\in\wedge(E)$) of [lem-weil-pbc-koszul-differential]; it maps $\wedge^n_R(E)$ into $\wedge^{n-1}_R(E)$, is the unique derivation of degree $-1$ with $D|_E=\varphi$, and is given on generators by $$D(v_1\wedge\dots\wedge v_n)=\sum_{i=1}^n(-1)^{i+1}\varphi(v_i)\,v_1\wedge\dots\wedge\widehat{v_i}\wedge\dots\wedge v_n\qquad(v_1,\dots,v_n\in E).$$ The *Koszul complex* $K_\bullet(f_1,\dots,f_r)=K_\bullet(R,f_1,\dots,f_r)$ is the chain complex of $R$-modules [def-weil-pbc-module-chain-complex-homology] with $K_n=\wedge^n_R(E)$ for $n\ge0$, $K_n=0$ for $n<0$, and differential $d_n:K_n\to K_{n-1}$ the restriction of $D$ ($d_n=0$ for $n\le0$); it is a complex because $d_{n-1}\circ d_n=0$ [lem-weil-pbc-koszul-differential-square-zero]. (With the product of $\wedge(E)$ it is the commutative differential graded algebra $K_\bullet(\varphi)$ of Stacks 0622.) By [lem-weil-pbc-exterior-power-free-basis], $K_n$ is free with basis $e_{i_1}\wedge\dots\wedge e_{i_n}$, $1\le i_1<\dots<i_n\le r$, so $K_0=R$, $K_1=E$ and $K_n=0$ for $n>r$; in low degrees $d_1(e_i)=f_i$ and $d_2(e_i\wedge e_j)=f_ie_j-f_je_i$. For an $R$-module $M$ write $K_\bullet(f_1,\dots,f_r)\otimes_RM$ for the chain complex with terms $K_n\otimes_RM$ and differentials $d_n\otimes\mathrm{id}_M$ [def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product] (a complex since $(d_{n-1}\otimes\mathrm{id}_M)\circ(d_n\otimes\mathrm{id}_M)=(d_{n-1}\circ d_n)\otimes\mathrm{id}_M=0$), and $H_i(-)=\ker d_i/\operatorname{im}d_{i+1}$ for the homology of a chain complex [def-weil-pbc-module-chain-complex-homology].
